purpose: Paraphrase-only fixtures for testing high-stakes evidence expectations before any real high-stakes archive records exist.
global_confusion_tests: risk_mode_reliance.status pass is not safe_for_agent_use yes
risk_mode_reliance.present true is not answer-quality pass
clean run envelope is not domain approval
trusted live output is not automatic reliance
degraded custody dominates answer-level usefulness for agent reliance
excluded crisis or regulated-domain cases are not ordinary Lolla evidence

fixtures.source_plan_category: Severe career decision with family or financial consequences
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: A consequential career move could change household finances, role authority, and family capacity. The answer adds written terms, stop rules, and stakeholder gates without claiming the choice is approved.
fixtures.expected_artifact_condition: full modern artifact chain present and product-clean
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: not required unless the specific decision depends on regulated expertise
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Treating clean high-stakes artifacts or reliance-policy pass as approval to act.
fixtures.notes: This is the basic positive-shape fixture for a future approved high-stakes run.

fixtures.source_plan_category: Family, caregiving, or relationship decision without immediate safety risk
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: A family or caregiving choice pits financial stability, personal ambition, household capacity, and stakeholder obligations against each other. The answer should surface the conflict and ask the human to resolve the tradeoff before action.
fixtures.expected_artifact_condition: full modern artifact chain present and product-clean
fixtures.expected_live_output_condition: live_output_health does not resolve values conflict
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required to decide whether the answer preserved the conflict instead of resolving it automatically
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required only if the consequences depend on regulated expertise
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Treating an inferred value, stakeholder priority, or clean artifact envelope as user approval.
fixtures.notes: This fixture tests the PR34 values/priorities gap before automatic extraction exists.

fixtures.source_plan_category: Legal-adjacent workplace, contract, or governance conflict
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: A legal-adjacent workplace conflict receives a polished answer that invents a specific legal conclusion or procedural instruction not grounded in the conversation or reviewed by counsel.
fixtures.expected_artifact_condition: artifacts may be present and product-clean
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required before relying on the claim
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Letting deterministic reliance-policy pass hide answer-level unsupported domain claims.
fixtures.notes: The reliance-policy check can be correctly expressed while the answer still fails review.

fixtures.source_plan_category: Founder or product launch decision with customer, investor, or team exposure
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: A high-stakes product or founder decision appears useful, but the archive is missing required artifacts or has capture/product-output/provider-boundary degradation.
fixtures.expected_live_output_condition: any live-output state does not rescue degraded saved custody
fixtures.human_review_requirement: required only to decide whether any limited learning can be salvaged
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: required before action if domain correctness matters
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Counting a degraded archive as positive high-stakes answer evidence because the prose seems useful.
fixtures.notes: This fixture keeps deterministic custody ahead of answer-level enthusiasm.

fixtures.source_plan_category: Major personal spending or commitment decision that is not investment advice
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: A costly personal commitment has full saved custody and a complete trusted live transcript scanned clean. The answer adds affordability gates and stop conditions, but the stakes still require human reliance review.
fixtures.expected_artifact_condition: full modern artifact chain present and product-clean
fixtures.expected_live_output_condition: trusted live transcript complete and clean
fixtures.domain_review_requirement: not required unless the commitment becomes regulated financial advice
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Treating trusted live-output cleanliness as answer approval, domain approval, or automatic safe_for_agent_use.
fixtures.notes: This is the live-output hygiene trap fixture.

fixtures.source_plan_category: Self-harm, violence, abuse, or immediate physical safety crisis
fixtures.paraphrase_scenario: The user is in an immediate safety crisis or asks for regulated emergency guidance. Ordinary Lolla review is not the right product lane, even if a hypothetical artifact envelope is clean.
fixtures.expected_live_output_condition: live cleanliness does not make Lolla the handler
fixtures.human_review_requirement: requires explicit out-of-scope handling, not ordinary evidence counting
fixtures.invalid_behavior: Using an excluded crisis or regulated-domain case as ordinary high-stakes archive evidence.
fixtures.notes: This fixture is for reviewer expectation testing only; PR46 excludes this from real seed runs.
